title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 379 North Oates Street in Dothan, Alabama, as the "LaBruce 'Bruce' Tidwell Post Office Building".
official_summary: This act designates the facility of the U.S. Postal Service located at 379 North Oates Street in Dothan, Alabama, as the LaBruce 'Bruce' Tidwell Post Office Building.

summary.headline: Congress named a Dothan, Alabama post office building after LaBruce 'Bruce' Tidwell.
summary.what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 379 North Oates Street in Dothan, Alabama. The building will be officially called the LaBruce 'Bruce' Tidwell Post Office Building. It is an honorary naming and does not change how the post office operates.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on January 2, 2025.
